```yaml
name: Auto-close stale PRs

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at midnight UTC
    - cron: "0 0 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  close-stale-prs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Close stale PRs
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          MAINTAINER: jdx
          EXEMPT_LABEL: keep-open
          DAYS_THRESHOLD: 30
        run: |
          # Fetch open PRs
          prs=$(gh pr list --state open --json number,author,labels,createdAt --repo "$REPO")
          
          # Get current timestamp in seconds
          now=$(date +%s)
          threshold_seconds=$((DAYS_THRESHOLD * 24 * 60 * 60))
          
          echo "$prs" | jq -c '.[]' | while read -r pr; do
            pr_number=$(echo "$pr" | jq -r '.number')
            author=$(echo "$pr" | jq -r '.author.login')
            created_at=$(echo "$pr" | jq -r '.createdAt')
            labels=$(echo "$pr" | jq -r '.labels[].name')
            
            # Check if author is maintainer
            if [ "$author" = "$MAINTAINER" ]; then
              echo "Skipping PR #$pr_number by maintainer $author"
              continue
            fi
            
            # Check if PR has exempt label
            if echo "$labels" | grep -q "^${EXEMPT_LABEL}$"; then
              echo "Skipping PR #$pr_number with label $EXEMPT_LABEL"
              continue
            fi
            
            # Calculate age in seconds
            created_timestamp=$(date -d "$created_at" +%s)
            age_seconds=$((now - created_timestamp))
            
            if [ "$age_seconds" -gt "$threshold_seconds" ]; then
              echo "Closing PR #$pr_number (age: $((age_seconds / 86400)) days)"
              
              # Post comment explaining closure
              gh pr comment "$pr_number" --repo "$REPO" --body "This PR has been automatically closed due to inactivity for more than $DAYS_THRESHOLD days.
              
              If you would like to continue working on this PR, please reopen it. If you need assistance, feel free to reach out to the maintainers."
              
              # Close the PR
              gh pr close "$pr_number" --repo "$REPO" --comment "Auto-closed due to inactivity"
            else
              echo "PR #$pr_number is not yet stale (age: $((age_seconds / 86400)) days)"
            fi
          done
```
